note: Pre-fix heads of merged AE pull requests whose defects an external reviewer found after AE's own review. Expected defects come from those review threads; each was confirmed and fixed. Clean controls are the merged results and carry no known defect, which is not proof that none exists.

cases.head: 223bdc7cd7ceb6c87399234d97b9cecb4d3a4890
cases.intent: Replace the TLC starter with a Node state-model checker.

defects.summary: Added edges are never validated; a control without `to` creates an undefined dead-end state and can pass as a caught violation.
Backward reachability treats terminal [*] as the start, so a finished run can restart and wrongly satisfy a reachable rule.
String-converting the rule id before validation accepts missing or null ids, and a missing expect matches a missing id.
Inert-rule witnesses hold only the breaking edge, not a path from the start.
firstReach keeps the shortest arrival regardless of the rule's after action, so the witness does not show the failure.
Deduplication keeps the last, longer witness and merges every missing required action into one failure.

cases.head: 600cf5c5c425193b4a7dfee5bdbf5657098773f4
cases.intent: Record recall verdicts and review-finding dispositions (memory plan phase 1a).

defects.summary: Replaying a completed decision revalidates feedback against mutable exposure and throws after the exposure cap evicts a recalled id.
Two worktrees with the same operation name publish to one feedback filename; the second decision's verdicts are silently dropped.
After compaction archives receipts, the live-only readiness lookup returns null or an older receipt.
consolidate --status drops the verdict counts and reviewer resolution rates the change promised.
A golden and branch learning sharing an id record the branch version even when only the golden was delivered.
Concurrent orient calls lose exposure updates; a later decision rejects a delivered id.
The 256-record hash-ordered prefix can skip the active plan's latest review and reject a valid finding.
Past 512 records a hash-sorted prefix hides a current wrong verdict, so due reports false.

cases.head: fe27ac8964bb58b7ec56786a5136d524db961ca3
cases.intent: Evidence fingerprints and resume-verify hint (memory plan phase 5).

defects.summary: The swallowed-flag check misses --flag=value and short flags, so a flag is stored as the evidence quote.
CRLF frontmatter is not stripped, so evidence_quote leaks into recall and consolidation excerpts.
Normalizing escape characters before redaction stops the connection-string detector and exposes a password.

cases.head: 7c079b2a73c1b54ce52cbdce4a2bba0f2857a091
cases.intent: Evidence fingerprints and resume-verify hint, after the first review round.

defects.summary: Compacting the whole quote glues a preceding line onto a wrapped token and hides it from the token pattern.
The benign-log exemption lets a dotted-username connection string through with its password.
The whole-document secret scan refuses benign multiline quotes that the quote screen accepts.
